entries.femaleVariant: No. Wait. Which apartment is this?
entries.maleVariant: No. Wait. Which apartment is this?

entries.femaleVariant: Not an apartment. Clinic. Name's V. I'm getting you out.
entries.maleVariant: Not an apartment. Clinic. Name's V. I'm getting you out.

entries.femaleVariant: Mara. I think. Keep saying it if I stop answering.
entries.maleVariant: Mara. I think. Keep saying it if I stop answering.

entries.femaleVariant: I have her signal. It is carrying six identity headers and one live panic response. The panic is Mara.
entries.maleVariant: I have her signal. It is carrying six identity headers and one live panic response. The panic is Mara.

entries.femaleVariant: Hallway should turn left here.
entries.maleVariant: Hallway should turn left here.

entries.femaleVariant: It doesn't.
entries.maleVariant: It doesn't.

entries.femaleVariant: I know. That's the problem.
entries.maleVariant: I know. That's the problem.

entries.femaleVariant: Smell that? Burned dust. Unit Thirty-Eight had the same vent motor.
entries.maleVariant: Smell that? Burned dust. Unit Thirty-Eight had the same vent motor.

entries.femaleVariant: Your unit?
entries.maleVariant: Your unit?

entries.femaleVariant: I don't know anymore.
entries.maleVariant: I don't know anymore.

entries.femaleVariant: Outside. Good. Outside only has one sky.
entries.maleVariant: Outside. Good. Outside only has one sky.

entries.femaleVariant: Sit her down. I can quiet the foreign loops, but the jammer kept them compressed. When they rebound, she may not know which body is hers.
entries.maleVariant: Sit her down. I can quiet the foreign loops, but the jammer kept them compressed. When they rebound, she may not know which body is hers.

entries.femaleVariant: I know which body hurts.
entries.maleVariant: I know which body hurts.

entries.femaleVariant: Hold the perimeter. Ninety seconds.
entries.maleVariant: Hold the perimeter. Ninety seconds.

entries.femaleVariant: Someone is unlocking my front door.
entries.maleVariant: Someone is unlocking my front door.

entries.femaleVariant: Nobody's here but us.
entries.maleVariant: Nobody's here but us.

entries.femaleVariant: Keep her on your voice. Do not argue with the memory; give her something present.
entries.maleVariant: Keep her on your voice. Do not argue with the memory; give her something present.

entries.femaleVariant: Blue wall. Water stain over the kitchen light.
entries.maleVariant: Blue wall. Water stain over the kitchen light.

entries.femaleVariant: Asphalt. Rain. Gunfire. Stay with those.
entries.maleVariant: Asphalt. Rain. Gunfire. Stay with those.

entries.femaleVariant: Foreign loops are isolated. She is still Mara.
entries.maleVariant: Foreign loops are isolated. She is still Mara.

entries.femaleVariant: That sounded less certain in your head.
entries.maleVariant: That sounded less certain in your head.

entries.femaleVariant: This room only belongs to one person. I checked.
entries.maleVariant: This room only belongs to one person. I checked.

entries.femaleVariant: Find the apartment with the green kitchen. I remember the key. I want to know whose hand it belongs to.
entries.maleVariant: Find the apartment with the green kitchen. I remember the key. I want to know whose hand it belongs to.
